title: Neural Estimation of Irreversibility in Real and Simulated Limit Order Book Paths
abstract: arXiv:2610.16151v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: A path indistinguishable from its own reverse carries no arrow of time, so time irreversibility is a necessary condition for a directed mechanism to be readable from trajectories alone. In finance it has been measured only on scalar series such as returns and volatility. We define the irreversibility rate of a coarse-grained limit order book path as the forward-to-reverse log-density ratio per event, and estimate it from three weeks of Nasdaq market-by-order data with an order-invariant MLP and a temporal convolutional network that receive identical blocks. For NVDA, the order-invariant and order-sensitive estimates are 0.036 and 0.054 nats per event, respectively. Their difference, the ordering increment, is 0.018. A surrogate preserving the coarse one-step transition table recovers 30 percent less irreversibility than the observed paths. translated_title: 真实与模拟限价订单簿路径中不可逆性的神经估计
translated_abstract: 一条与其自身逆序不可区分的路径不携带时间之箭，因此时间不可逆性是仅凭轨迹即可读取有向机制的必要条件。在金融领域，该性质此前仅在收益率和波动率等标量序列上被测量过。我们将粗粒化限价订单簿路径的不可逆率定义为每个事件的前向-逆向对数密度比，并利用接收相同数据块的顺序不变多层感知机（MLP）和时间卷积网络，从三周的纳斯达克逐笔委托（market-by-order）数据中对其进行估计。对于NVDA，顺序不变与顺序敏感的估计值分别为每事件0.036和0.054 nats，其差值（即排序增量）为0.018。一个保留粗粒化单步转移表的替代数据所恢复的不可逆性比观测路径低30%。该增量在全部十二只标的的每个留出白天日期上均为正，且对于NVDA（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文首次将时间不可逆性的度量从标量金融序列拓展到多变量限价订单簿路径，通过神经网络估计发现订单排序本身贡献了显著且在所有十二只股票上稳定为正的不可逆性增量。
en_tdlr: This paper extends time-irreversibility measurement from scalar financial series to multivariate limit order book paths, using neural estimators to show that order sequencing itself contributes a significant irreversibility increment that is consistently positive across all twelve symbols.
